sources.note: Main company website. Describes Claimpower as offering medical billing services, EHR, practice management, credentialing, and MIPS support. Emphasizes 'big company benefits, small company touch' for small practices.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Confirms Mobile EMR V6.1 certification, states EMR is 'not offered as a stand-alone software' (only for billing clients). Lists pricing: ePrescribing $25/prescriber/month, Direct Messaging $15/address/month, text messaging $0.10/text, document indexing $0.10/page.

EHR product page. Describes cloud-based, device-agnostic EMR with customizable templates, Dragon voice integration, lab orders/results, secure messaging, CCM/TCM support, and MIPS submission assistance.

Practice management page. Describes eligibility checking, patient balances, payment collection, customizable super bills, reporting, paper chart digitization, text messaging, eFaxing, credit card processing.

Managed billing services page. Details daily electronic claims submission, proprietary scrubbing software, ERA/EOB posting, coding services (CPT/ICD-10), denial management, appeals, and soft collections.
Blog post from 2019 about new patient queue feature allowing EMR access directly from the queue interface.

ZoomInfo company profile. Describes Claimpower as family-run, founded 1992, based in Glen Rock NJ. Mentions services including medical billing, proprietary EMR, value-based/payer contract enrollment, remote patient monitoring, AI-driven charting, eligibility, appeal management, and auditing. States they serve 'hundreds of doctors in small practices.' (Page returned 403 on direct fetch; info from search snippet.)
LinkedIn profile of CEO Rohan Thadani. Confirmed family-run company (parents founded it in 1992), Rohan promoted from COO to CEO.
EMR application URL. Redirects to portal.claimpower.com — this is the live EMR login/application portal, no public feature descriptions visible.
